subject: Subprocessor roster & export-path confirmation — PayLumen pilot
messages:
From: Alex Moran <amoran@paylumen.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@paylumen.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — subprocessor roster + export paths for pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the PayLumen pilot team are keen to validate the data path and subprocessors before we flip the switch for a small production pilot. Legal has a couple of narrow asks: can you share your current subprocessor roster (vendor, role, country) and confirm whether any of the processors touch production data in India or China? Also: any temporary/ephemeral analytics providers we should be aware of for the pilot window.

If you can send a short spreadsheet and any pointer to SOC2 or export-evidence, that would let us finish the procurement checklist. We have a Friday deadline for the procurement packet.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Alex Moran
Head of Integrations, PayLumen
amoran@paylumen.com

Attachments: preliminary-questionnaire.pdf (referenced)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — subprocessor roster + export paths for pilot

Folks — forwarding PayLumen's request. They need: vendor/role/country, whether any processing touches India/China production, any ephemeral vendors for analytics/telemetry during the pilot, and SOC2/export evidence. Procurement wants this by Friday EOD (their timezone).

Ask: can Rishi pull the latest subprocessor roster, mark which vendors see production data for the pilot, and flag any vendors with cross-border egress (especially India/China)? Vivek — please confirm if the pilot will use the edge-relay in ap-south1 for latency testing (that would change transit paths). Laura — loop in legal if you see any DPA implications.

I'll consolidate and send back to PayLumen. Short turnaround — keep replies inline.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — subprocessor roster + export paths for pilot

Kim / team — attaching the clean subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx (vendor, role, country, data_tier, production_access_flag, notes). High level:

- Storage: EdgeStore Inc. — object store / backups — US, EU — production_access_flag: yes
- Transit/proxy: RelayBridge Ltd. — edge routing & TLS termination — US, Singapore (ephemeral) — production_access_flag: yes (pilot will route test traffic)
- Analytics (ephemeral): InsightPulse (contracted for pilot telemetry, short-term) — Singapore — production_access_flag: yes (telemetry only, tokenized)
- Observability: LogWave — EU (no India/China) — production_access_flag: no (metrics only)
- KMS/HSM: KeyHarbor (vendor-managed HSM in us-east1) — US — production_access_flag: yes

Notes: RelayBridge operates a transient POP in ap-south1 for the latency test — that means telemetry/relay hops may touch India. We can limit that by pinning to us-east-only for the pilot if PayLumen needs no India touch. SOC2 reports are on the vendor evidence drive; I'll add links to each vendor line in the spreadsheet.

Attaching roster (spreadsheet) + short export path column.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx

From: contracts@paylumen.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Moran <amoran@paylumen.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster & export-path confirmation — PayLumen pilot

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and spreadsheet. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether RelayBridge's transient POP in ap-south1 will see any customer PII in the pilot? If so, we'll need either onshore fallback or a documented export justification.
2) Please attach SOC2/attestation links for KeyHarbor and EdgeStore Inc.
3) Our legal team prepared a short DPA addendum for temporary analytics vendors (covers telemetry retention limits and access restrictions). Can you review the attached draft (dpa_addendum_draft.pdf) and execute via DocuSign? I will also share a DocuSign link once we confirm the party names.

If you can reply by EOD Wednesday, we can keep the pilot timeline intact.

Best,
PayLumen Contracts
contracts@paylumen.com
